title: Compositional Visual Generation with Composable Diffusion Models
idea: Treats each diffusion model as an energy function and adds their noise predictions at sampling time so one image satisfies several concepts.
models: Composed diffusion models trained on CLEVR and FFHQ; pre-trained GLIDE and Stable Diffusion for text
datasets: CLEVR, Relational CLEVR, FFHQ, text prompts
headline_result: CLEVR with 3 components at 128x128: binary classification accuracy 31.36% and FID 10.51, against 7.34% and 58.33 for the EBM baseline
evidence_quote: An image is generated by composing a set of diffusion models, with each of them modeling a certain component of the image.

title: Reduce, Reuse, Recycle: Compositional Generation with Energy-Based Diffusion Models and MCMC
idea: Blames failed composition on the reverse sampler and replaces it with annealed MCMC samplers, including Metropolis-corrected ones on an energy parameterization.
models: Score-based and energy-based diffusion models; Imagen 64x64 base model for image tapestries
datasets: 2D distributions, CLEVR cube positions, ImageNet 128x128 classifier guidance, composed text prompts
headline_result: CLEVR with 5 cube positions: 72.7% of samples place every object correctly with the energy model and HMC, against 57.4% for reverse sampling of the score model
evidence_quote: We conclude that the sampler (not the model) is responsible for this failure and propose new samplers, inspired by MCMC, which enable successful compositional generation.

title: Feynman-Kac Correctors in Diffusion: Annealing, Guidance, and Product of Experts
idea: Derives importance weights from the Feynman-Kac formula and resamples particles so sampling follows annealed, geometric-mean or product targets built from pretrained score models.
models: EDM2-XS on ImageNet-512 for images; pretrained molecule models
headline_result: EDM2 at noise level 40 and 32 steps over 10,000 images: CLIP 29.00 and ImageReward 0.04 with FKC, against 28.75 and -0.24 with CFG alone (the right half of the same table prints 29.14 and 0.05 for this setting)
evidence_quote: In this work, we provide an efficient and principled method for sampling from a sequence of annealed, geometric-averaged, or product distributions derived from pretrained score-based models.

title: The Superposition of Diffusion Models Using the Itô Density Estimator
idea: Combines pretrained diffusion models during sampling with weights from a new Itô density estimator, giving OR and AND style superpositions.
models: Stable Diffusion v1-4; CIFAR-10 models; Proteus and FrameDiff; molecule models
datasets: CIFAR-10 split into two disjoint partitions, 20 Stable Diffusion concept pairs, proteins, molecules
headline_result: Stable Diffusion concept pairs, 20 images for each of 20 pairs: minimum TIFA 39.92 for SuperDiff AND, against 32.48 for averaged scores and 27.58 for joint prompting
evidence_quote: We demonstrate that SuperDiff is scalable to large pre-trained diffusion models as superposition is performed solely through composition during inference, and also enjoys painless implementation as it combines different pre-trained vector fields through an automated re-weighting scheme.

title: Steer Away From Mode Collisions: Improving Composition In Diffusion Models
idea: Adds a corrector during sampling that steers away from regions where the joint prompt behaves like one of its single concepts, and keeps the guidance weights in a stable range.
models: SDXL, with SD 1.5 among the baselines
headline_result: Attend-and-Excite animal-animal prompts: BLIP-VQA 0.7441 and ImageReward 1.2342 for CO3, against 0.6980 and 0.8244 for Attend-and-Excite
evidence_quote: Instead of re-training, we introduce a corrective sampling strategy that steers away from regions where the joint prompt behavior overlaps too strongly with any single concept in the prompt.

title: Rectify Then Diffuse: Disentangling Concepts Before Denoising Trajectory Unfolds
idea: Makes one bounded update to the starting latent that reduces overlap between the concepts' attention maps, then runs ordinary denoising.
models: SDXL, with SD 1.5 among the baselines
headline_result: AE-Bench object-object prompts: BLIP-VQA 0.7503 for RTD against 0.5146 for CO3, the 45.8% gain the abstract reports, while animal-object BLIP-VQA is lower at 0.8422 against 0.8878
evidence_quote: To this end, we propose Rectify-then-Diffuse (RTD), a training-free framework that rectifies the initial allocation once before standard denoising.

title: Catastrophic Compositional Generation: Why Vanilla Diffusion Models Fail to Extrapolate
idea: Argues that when the composed target lies outside the training distributions, score estimation error dominates and inference-time correction such as Feynman-Kac cannot fix it.
models: Conditional diffusion models and separately trained diffusion models
datasets: 2D Gaussians, Gaussian mixtures, semi-synthetic room images
headline_result: Out-of-distribution Gaussian mixture with 256 particles: sliced Wasserstein-2 distance to the target 1.4670 with analytic scores, against 2.6706 with scores learned from 10,000 samples
evidence_quote: In particular, while recent methods such as Feynman-Kac correction reduce inference-time approximation error, our results show that score estimation error has a more catastrophic effect on performance when the target distribution is out-of-distribution with respect to the sources, highlighting the need for a different approach to this task.

models: Conditional diffusion models on CLEVR; SDXL fine-tuned on one dog for an illustration
headline_result: not stated
evidence_quote: Then, we investigate: (1) when linear score combinations provably achieve projective composition, (2) whether reverse-diffusion sampling can generate the desired composition, and (3) the conditions under which composition fails.

title: Local Mechanisms of Compositional Generalization in Conditional Diffusion
idea: Proves that conditional projective composition is equivalent to scores that depend sparsely on pixels and conditioners, and tests this on CLEVR and SDXL.

headline_result: Training on 1-3 objects, the largest object count reached (Kmax) rises from 2 to 9 when local conditional scores are enforced on Experiment 2
evidence_quote: In this paper, we prove an exact equivalence between a specific compositional structure ("conditional projective composition") (Bradley et al., 2025) and scores with sparse dependencies on both pixels and conditioners ("local conditional scores").

title: Logical Guidance for the Exact Composition of Diffusion Models
idea: Gives a sufficient condition for computing exact guidance for Boolean formulas from atomic scores and posterior probabilities.
models: Conditional diffusion models for images and protein structures
datasets: CMNIST, Shapes3D, CelebA, protein structure tasks
headline_result: CMNIST conformity score: 98.0% against 77.0% for constant guidance on mutually exclusive OR, and 80.4% for both on AND
evidence_quote: Specifically, if a formula admits a circuit representation in which conjunctions combine conditionally independent subformulas and disjunctions combine subformulas that are either conditionally independent or mutually exclusive, exact logical guidance is achievable.

title: Improving Compositional Generation with Diffusion Models Using Lift Scores
idea: Scores each generated sample with a lift score for every single condition and rejects samples that fail the composed condition.

title: Attend-and-Excite: Attention-Based Semantic Guidance for Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
idea: Updates the latent during sampling so the cross-attention map of every subject token reaches a strong activation.

datasets: Animal-animal, animal-object and object-object prompt sets

evidence_quote: Using an attention-based formulation of GSN, dubbed Attend-and-Excite, we guide the model to refine the cross-attention units to attend to all subject tokens in the text prompt and strengthen - or excite - their activations, encouraging the model to generate all subjects described in the text prompt.
